45789.summary: The class explores the purpose of suffering through the lens of Mary's journey with cancer, emphasizing that suffering is ultimately about growing faith and trust in God. It highlights the importance of focusing on one's relationship with God during trials to develop perseverance and a deeper understanding of divine justice and righteousness.

45790.summary: The class explores the purpose of suffering through the lens of Mary's journey with cancer, emphasizing that trials are meant to strengthen faith and draw believers closer to God. It highlights the importance of trusting God's wisdom and justice even when the big picture is unclear.
